name: blaze-shield
author: BlaXun, Ragnarok Offline
description: Make Blaze Shield (NJ_KAENSIN) a real Ninja build. Each option has its own checkbox: drain bonuses on every pillar hit, Hylozoist Card's polymorph on every pillar hit, and pillars that hold monsters in place instead of letting them walk through.

settings.label: Drain on every pillar hit
settings.description: HP/SP drain bonuses (Moonlight Dagger's SP drain and the rest) fire on each pillar hit, not only on weapon attacks.

settings.label: Hylozoist Card on every pillar hit
settings.description: Hylozoist Card's polymorph rolls on each pillar hit. Bosses and status-immune monsters are never changed.

settings.label: Pillars hold monsters
settings.description: A monster stepping onto a pillar is hit at once and held there until the pillar burns out, so fast monsters cannot walk through the field. Endure and boss monsters still walk on.
